TimetableSlot.title: TimetableSlot
TimetableSlot.description: Represents a scheduled academic period in either KKHM Islamic & Arts College (WAFY) or Al-Gaith Islamic & Arts College for Girls (WAFIYYA), supporting science double periods, PG Mon-Wed schedules, cross-campus faculty clustering, and 3-way split electives.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this workspace.

campus.description: Campus identifier (WAFY Boys Campus or WAFIYYA Girls Campus).

batchName.description: Academic class/batch name (e.g., Tamheediyya Ula, Aliya Ula, PG 1).

subjectNameArabic.description: Arabic calligraphic title for Kitab/Islamic subjects.

facultyId.description: Identifier of the assigned faculty member.

facultyName.description: Name of the assigned faculty member.

isDoublePeriod.description: True if this slot is part of a consecutive Science Lab double period.

isCrossCampusFaculty.description: True if the faculty member teaches across both Wafy and Wafiyya campuses.

electiveSubBatches.description: Details of split-batch electives (e.g., Urdu / Malayalam / Arabic).

roomName.description: Assigned lecture hall or lab room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PeriodAudit.title: PeriodAudit
PeriodAudit.description: 3:30 PM Daily Period Audit record submitted by a Class Leader or Admin, tracking conducted, missed, substituted, and compensated classes.

dateString.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the audited period.

missReason.description: Reason if the period was missed or substituted.

substituteFaculty.description: Name of substitute faculty if substituted.

classLeaderName.description: Name or role of the Class Leader who recorded the 3:30 PM audit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SemesterConfig.title: SemesterConfig
SemesterConfig.description: Academic semester working days, holidays, and deficit calculation tracker per campus.

totalCalendarDays.description: Total calendar days in the semester span.

examAndEventDays.description: Exam and special event non-instructional days.

completedWorkingDays.description: Completed instructional working days so far.

makeupDaysScheduled.description: Additional makeup working days scheduled to offset deficit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FacultyMember.title: FacultyMember
FacultyMember.description: Faculty profile with cross-campus travel clustering preference and weekly workload.

name.description: Full name of the faculty member.

primaryCampus.description: Assigned campus or BOTH for shared cross-campus faculty.

subjects.description: Subjects taught by the faculty member.

preferredCluster.description: Travel clustering mode for the High-Density Timetable Optimizer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/timetable_slots/{slotId}.description: Per-user timetable slots for Wafy and Wafiyya campuses.

/users/{userId}/period_audits/{auditId}.description: Per-user 3:30 PM daily period audit records and compensation tracking.

/users/{userId}/semester_configs/{config.description: Per-user academic semester working day and deficit configurations.

/users/{userId}/faculty_members/{faculty.description: Per-user faculty roster and cross-campus clustering constraints.
